LanguageData.ArabicSupport_UseCustomFont_Tip: Replace RimWorld's UI font with the font chosen below.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_NoFontsFoundIn: No fonts found in {0}. Please reinstall the mod.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_FontsFolderHelp_RW17: Fonts live in: {0}. To add another font, copy its .fontbundle, .ttf or .otf file into that folder (more fonts are in the FontLibrary folder of the mod's GitHub page).
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_FontsFolderHelp_Unity: Fonts live in: {0}. To add another font, copy its .fontbundle file into that folder (more fonts are in the FontLibrary folder of the mod's GitHub page).
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_ApplyToTextFields: Also use it in text fields
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_ApplyToTextFields_Tip: Use the custom font for typing boxes (search fields, renaming, etc.) too.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_HarakatPlacement_Tip: Draws fatha, tanween, shadda... on top of the letter they belong to (for example tanween on a final alef). Works with fonts made for this mod.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_PrewarmGlyphs_Tip: Draws all Arabic and English letters once when the font is applied, so the game doesn't stutter the first time a new letter appears.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_TextInputFix_Tip: Lets you type Arabic in names, search boxes and other text boxes: letters are joined and ordered like the translation. Search boxes also find Arabic words while you type.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_SizeNeedsFont: Turn on the custom font to change sizes and positions.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_WrapByPixels: Wrap Arabic text by its real width
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_WrapByPixels_Tip: Breaks Arabic lines by measuring the real width of the text, so the line you read first comes first. Turn this off to let the game wrap Arabic text by itself.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_KeepLatinRuns_Tip: A name or phrase in English, such as a colonist's name, never splits across two lines. Numbers next to it stay with it.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_SplitWideWords: Cut words wider than the line
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_SplitWideWords_Tip: When a single word is wider than its whole box, cut it in reading order. Without this option the game cuts it from the wrong side.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_WrapMarginLine: Safety margin at the end of a line: {0}px
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_WrapMargin_Help: Lines break this many pixels earlier. Raise it if the last letter of a line is cut off.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_GrowLabelHeight: Leave room for dots and tails
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_GrowLabelHeight_Tip: Makes a one-line label a few pixels taller when it needs it, so the dots under a final yeh and the tails of reh, waw and qaf are not cut off.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_ClearCaches_Help: Forgets every wrapped and measured text; the game rebuilds them as it draws. Use it if some text still looks wrong after you changed an option.
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_Status_Waiting: Waiting for the game to start drawing...
LanguageData.ArabicSupport_Status_GameFontsNotReady: RimWorld's own fonts are not ready; the custom font is unavailable.
